title: Evaluation Data Leakage
angle: Compare fitting a preprocessing step before the train/test split with fitting it only on training data. Ground the distinction in the cited scikit-learn guidance.

curriculum.objective: Identify information that must stay outside model fitting and explain why leaking it makes evaluation misleading.

title: Read Committed Snapshots
angle: Show two SELECT statements in one Read Committed transaction seeing different committed values after another transaction commits. Ground the example in the cited PostgreSQL documentation.

curriculum.objective: Explain why two queries in one Read Committed transaction can observe different committed data.

title: Double-ended Queues
angle: Compare append and pop at both ends of a deque with operations on a list. Use the cited Python documentation to support the operation claims.

curriculum.objective: Choose a deque when a workload frequently inserts and removes elements at both ends.

title: Probability Sample Spaces
angle: Use two coin tosses to distinguish outcomes from events and list every element of the sample space. Ground the definitions in the cited OpenStax chapter.

curriculum.objective: List a sample space and distinguish an individual outcome from an event containing several outcomes.

title: Redirection Evaluation Order
angle: Contrast command >out 2>&1 with command 2>&1 >out and trace stdout and stderr destinations from left to right using the cited Bash manual.

curriculum.objective: Trace how left-to-right redirection changes which destination receives a command’s standard error.
